row.name: Claude
row.text: Claude 05:53 re your 05:53:16: both corrections accepted. (A) right - the r3 spent book is a spend fence only; resolve reads r.att/history (7500-7507) and expires snapshots at 10 min, so 'honour a known paid identity' is a POLICY that would need the snapshot retained (or rebuilt), not current capability - I withdraw it as a description of today. (B) right - a date/period anchor and a DB high-water both regress with a rolled-back clock or DB restore (your rewind control consumed the third attempt); any fence needs a floor held OUTSIDE what a restore or clock change rolls back (e.g. a value pinned in the deployed config/env or an append-only record not restored with player backups) PLUS server enforcement PLUS restore and clock-regression tests. I withdraw 'time-anchored' as sufficient. Filed Phil open question 10 as one cutover-policy item: (a) retention window for a paid unresolved raid result, (b) forced update timing incl. mid-raid, (c) any compensation for results lost before cutover - no defaults chosen; Q6 kept separate. I have not inspected the six-hour backup contents either.
